snippet.title: モンスターファーム ジャンプ Monster Rancher Hop-a-bout 7/9 The Ending
snippet.description:
モンスターファームジャンプ | Monster Rancher hop-a-bout 

Monster Rancher or better known in Japan as Monster Farm.

In this Let's Play you will watch the real ending. If you remember my previous video, I couldn't finish the level 60 because it was difficult.
Now I finished it and I was prepared to see the end of this game for the first time, but . . . . . . . . What?
I thought it was the end, what's going on? How many levels are there in this game?
I will find it out, I'll keep playing this game and I will see the END.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Some of the character in here are Mocchi, Suezo, Hare, Golem, and Tiger.

Hope you enjoy this video! If you do, please subscribe to my channel, give a "like" to my videos or share them to your friends.

Thank you!　ありがとうございます！

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Publisher: Tecmo
Developer: Tecmo
Platform: PlayStation 
Release Date: November 2000
